description: Set a sequence's in and out points around clips: the clips under the playhead (Markers > Mark Clip) or the given or selected clips (Markers > Mark Selection), from the earliest start to the latest end. One undo step

clips.description: The clips to mark around (items from list_clips, or selected: true for Mark Selection). Default the clips under the playhead

items.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

selected.description: Include the clips selected in the Timeline

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

track.description: Only clips on this kind of track (give with trackIndex); default every video and audio track

trackIndex.description: Only this track, 0 = V1 or A1 (with track)

name: mark_clips
title: Mark Clips
